notes: Units: all amounts Rs crore unless the key says otherwise (_rs = rupees per unit, _pct = percent, _number = count, _mn = million units). Every source statement is presented in Rs million (INR mn, 2 decimals); converted by dividing by 10. No lakh-denominated figures were used.

Verification (5 years): ALL CHECKS PASSED. Checks run on the million figures: PBT - total tax = PAT; current+deferred+earlier-years tax = total tax; revenue + other income = total income; sum of expense lines = total expenses and total income - total expenses = PBT; revenue split and Ind AS 115 reconciliation; other income split; impairment split; D&A split; NCI + owners = PAT; total assets = total equity and liabilities and every BS subtotal re-adds; PPE gross - acc. dep - impairment = net block; intangibles roll-up; DTL - DTA = net DTL; NC + current borrowings = total borrowings; every CF subtotal re-adds; CFO+CFI+CFF = net change; opening (+ cash acquired) + net change = closing; CF closing cash = BS cash and cash equivalents. NDCF statements (trust and five SPVs, both frameworks) re-add to their reported totals.

FY22 is NOT a full 12-month year: PGInvIT acquired its SPVs on 13 May 2021, so FY22 consolidated figures cover 13-May-2021 to 31-Mar-2022 (no prior-year comparatives exist). FY22 cash flow therefore starts from 'cash and cash equivalents as on the acquisition date' (cash_acquired_on_acquisition_date) with opening cash 0.

Project-wise revenue (rev_VTL ... rev_JPTL) is from the Ind AS 115 note; FY26 project lines sum to 12,580.27 mn vs 12,580.28 total (rounding in source).

Other income: oi_interest_income + oi_mf_income + oi_other = other income. PGInvIT reports no mutual fund income; the note fully breaks down the total, so oi_mf_income = 0. Interest on Indian bank deposits alone is oi_interest_indian_banks (the figure deducted in the cash flow).

Impairment: FY22 impairment is goodwill only (3,679.41 mn). FY23 15,098.10 mn = goodwill 5,896.50 + PPE 8,675.27 + intangibles 526.33. FY24/FY25/FY26 are reversals of PPE and intangible impairment. Balance-sheet 'impairment' = accumulated PPE impairment provision (FY25/FY26 schedule presentation; the FY2023-24 report folded impairment into accumulated depreciation, so FY23 accumulated depreciation is taken from the FY2024-25 report's opening column); intangible impairment provision is a separate key. Ace Equity puts the impairment in misc expenses (FY23) and the reversals in other income (FY24-FY26), and adds the FY22 goodwill impairment to depreciation; it otherwise matches these figures.

Gross block FY22 = 110,826.36 mn (FY23 opening column; FY22 closing column prints 110,826.37). Intangibles FY22 gross 4,844.16 / acc. amortisation 179.50 taken from the FY23 opening column (the FY22 closing column shows 4,844.23 / 179.57, including a fully amortised 0.07 mn software asset).

Borrowings: one secured HDFC Bank term loan at the Trust (5,755.85 mn drawn Mar-2022; second tranche 5,060.00 mn Dec-2024). short_term_borrowings = null (none); current_maturities = current borrowings (current maturities of the term loan). total_borrowings_carrying = non-current + current (net of unamortised transaction cost) = the cash-flow-statement debt reconciliation closing balance; total_borrowings_principal_term_loan = gross loan before unamortised cost (the 'Long term debt' figure used in the gearing ratio).

BS null vs 0: 0 = line presented with a dash; null = line not presented that year (e.g. goodwill after FY24, NCI line dropped in FY26 after 100% ownership from 30-Dec-2024, nc_other_financial_assets before FY25). Long-term provisions, non-current investments, current investments and short-term borrowings are never presented. other_non_current_assets_incl_financial and other_current_assets are DERIVED sums of reported lines (stated in sources); the reported components are kept alongside.

NCI: PGInvIT held 74% of KATL, PPTL, WTL, JPTL until it bought the remaining 26% from POWERGRID on 30-Dec-2024 (5,066.29 mn) and bought 26% of VTL on 31-Mar-2022 (3,307.85 mn); minority_interest_share is the P&L NCI share (negative = loss attributable to NCI). From FY26 there is no NCI.

Cash flow: lines are as reported; null = line absent from that year's statement, 0 = shown as a dash. 'wc_earmarked_bank_balances' for FY23 is the restated line; the original FY23 statement had '(Increase)/Decrease in bank balances other than cash (121.40)'. FY25-FY26 CFO no longer shows 'Income tax refund received' separately.

Distributions: distributions_paid_in_year and dpu_paid_* are amounts PAID during the fiscal year (Q4 of prior year + Q1-Q3), with the component split from the consolidated capital management note. dpu_declared_* relate to distributions DECLARED for the fiscal year (Q1-Q4, incl. the Q4 amount declared after year end) from the highlights pages; FY26 declared split is disclosed only in percent (per-rupee amounts left null). FY22 declared = 10.50 (4.50 for 13-May to 30-Sep-2021 shown in dpu_declared_q2_rs, then 3.00 for Q3 and Q4). NDCF: FY22-FY24 under the old SEBI framework (trust_old_* and spv_<SPV>_old_* lines, every line of the statements incl. zeros); FY25-FY26 under the revised framework of SEBI circular dated 15-May-2024 (trust_new_*, spv_<SPV>_new_*). The two frameworks are not like-for-like. ndcf_trust_level and ndcf_spv_level_<SPV> give the reported headline NDCF for all years; ndcf_spv_level_sum_of_5_spvs is a derived sum. SPV names: VTL (Vizag), KATL (Kala Amb, formerly PKATL), PPTL (Parli), WTL (Warora, formerly PWTL), JPTL (Jabalpur, formerly PJTL). In FY26 the JPTL capex line is printed as a positive 65.73 (sum re-adds as printed).
